notes.title: v0.3.1.1 - Demo Bug Fix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497190/367fd6456e2d20e48dec10c37f5e12a9ef55575b.png[/img]
[h2]Window Dragging & Mouse Lock Improvements[/h2]
[h2]Update Details:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game window could not be dragged in windowed mode.
[*] The mouse is now locked only during gameplay. In other menus (main menu, pause menu, options, etc.), you can freely move, resize, and drag the window.
[*] Multi-monitor setup: We've attempted to fix the issue where the game launches on the secondary monitor. We would greatly appreciate it if affected players could check and let us know if the issue persists.
[/list]

tags.bug: [*] Fixed an issue where the game window could not be dragged in windowed mode.

[*] Multi-monitor setup: We've attempted to fix the issue where the game launches on the secondary monitor. We would greatly appreciate it if affected players could check and let us know if the issue persists.

notes.title: Version 0.3.0.0 - Demo Stages Revamped
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497190/fc4b792a6c3b37f5b714dee312a0807b91cf21fb.png[/img]
[h2]All demo stages have been completely revamped!
[/h2]
We have also improved the art and systems.

Get ready for a fresh and improved experience, now you really need to think to pass!

We would appreciate your feedback and suggestions in the Discussions.


[b][h2]Update Details:[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] All demo stages were revamped.
[*] Added a new mechanism to existing traps.
[*] Demo progress can now be saved.
[*] New stages selection interface added.
[*] Added tutorial instructions.
[*] Updated UI Art.
[/list]

notes.title: Game Window Size Fix – Version 0.2.1.0
notes.content:
We've found an issue where the game window size would reset when transitioning between scenes. Now, your selected screen size setting (fullscreen or windowed mode) will persist as expected.

Fix Details:

[list]
[*]Resolved screen size resetting when loading new scenes.
[/list]
